headline: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
summary: New Mexico's Supreme Court fined a lawyer $5,000. He included AI-fabricated witnesses and fake police testimony. This occurred in an appeal for a murder conviction.

headline: Matt Mullenweg returns as Automattic CEO two days after getting booted
summary: Matt Mullenweg was reinstated as Automattic CEO. This follows a two-day paid leave of absence. His return was confirmed via a Slack message and X post.

headline: We unfolded the iPhone Duo
summary: The Vergecast discussed Apple's rumored first folding phone. They analyzed Apple's recent launch event. Topics included John Ternus's debut as CEO and new devices.

headline: The White House says Truth Social is the ‘most powerful and popular social media platform in the world’
summary: The White House claimed Truth Social is the world's most powerful social media platform. This statement was provided by a White House spokesperson. It contradicts user data from major social media sites.

headline: Save $900 Off the Asus ROG Flow Z13 Gaming Laptop
summary: Get $900 off the Asus ROG Flow Z13 gaming laptop. This convertible offers power and versatility. It weighs only one pound more than a handheld gaming PC.

headline: Point Break TV Show Gets the Green Light at AMC
summary: AMC has given the green light to a 'Point Break' TV show. The series will expand on the iconic movie franchise. More details on production are expected soon.

headline: Save $10 Off the PlayStation 5 Disc Drive
summary: Save $10 on the PlayStation 5 Disc Drive. This accessory turns your PS5 Digital Edition into a 4K Blu-ray player. It's the best way to watch physical 4K movies.

headline: Walmart Has 512GB Nintendo Switch 2 Memory Card for Just $75
summary: Walmart is offering a 512GB Nintendo Switch 2 memory card for $75. A 256GB version is available for $37 with a hidden coupon. This is a must-have for avid Switch gamers.

headline: MPs vote against fresh attempt to legalise assisted dying
summary: Members of Parliament voted against a new bill. The proposed law sought to legalize assisted dying in the UK. This marks a setback for supporters of the measure.

headline: Why did MPs reject assisted dying bill this time?
summary: MPs surprisingly rejected the assisted dying bill. Supporters vow to try again in the future. Momentum for a change in the law has temporarily waned.

headline: America marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
summary: America commemorated the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks. Solemn ceremonies were held in New York City. Events also took place at the Pentagon and in Pennsylvania.

headline: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
summary: Iran-backed Houthis claim significant territorial gains in Yemen. They are reportedly tightening control over the Red Sea shipping lane. The group is also said to have seized strategic Perim island.
